    have h_extra :
        2 ^ ((k + 1) - (k + 1)) * Nat.choose ((k + 1) + (k + 1)) (k + 1) = 2 ^ (k + 1) := by
      simp
    have h_first :
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k,

          2 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k,
                2 ^ (k - j) * Nat.choose (k + j) j) := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      have hsub : (k + 1) - j = (k - j) + 1 := by
        have : j ≤ k := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hj).2
        exact (Nat.succ_sub (Nat.le_of_lt_succ this)).symm
      simp [hsub, pow_succ, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    calc
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 (k + 1),
          2 ^ ((k + 1) - j) * Nat.choose ((k + 1) + j) j) =
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k,
              2 ^ ((k + 1) - j) * Nat.choose ((k + 1) + j) j) +
          (2 ^ ((k + 1) - (k + 1)) * Nat.choose ((k + 1) + (k + 1)) (k + 1)) := by
        simpa [h_extra] using hsum
